arguments.command:
python -c "
import glom
from glom.core import Path, Literal, Spec, Coalesce, Inspect, Call, Invoke, Let, Auto, Fill, Check, T

# Test repr for all public specifiers
print('Path:', repr(Path(['a', 'b'])))
print('Literal:', repr(Literal(42)))
print('Spec:', repr(Spec))
print('Coalesce:', repr(Coalesce('a.b', 'c.d')))
print('Inspect:', repr(Inspect('a.b')))
print('Call:', repr(Call(str.upper)))
print('Invoke:', repr(Invoke(T.upper)))
print('Let:', repr(Let({'x': T.a})))
print('Auto:', repr(Auto()))
print('Fill:', repr(Fill({'a': 'b'})))
print('Check:', repr(Check(type=int)))
"
